description: Vedic calendar calculations and timing. Ritu = Hindu 6-season system. Solstice = equinox/solstice dates. Anandadi Yoga = 27 yogas from tithi+weekday. Auspicious/Inauspicious Yoga = daily favorable combos. Auspicious/Inauspicious Period = time windows for activities. Gowri Nalla Neram = South Indian Choghadiya. Disha Shool = inauspicious directions per weekday. Planet Transit = current transit positions. Chandrashtama = Moon in 8th from natal Moon (avoid important work). Cost: $0.016-0.020/call.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal zodiac correction. Default: lahiri. Only for Vedic calculations.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

type.description: Calendar calculation type. See tool description for details.

name: vedika_calendar
